text: ELECTRONIC LIVE DUO / DJS / PRODUCERS 500+ SHOWS 20+ COUNTRIES GENRE — MELODIC TECHNO / TECH HOUSE NEXT: 13.11 KUALA LUMPUR LOCAL 05:51 #01 DJ SET · #02 LIVE VOCALS · #03 GUITAR · #04 DRUMS BOOK THE SHOW ↗ WATCH LIVE ▶ SCROLL ↓ 39KINGDOM ✱ (02) WELCOME TO OUR KINGDOM ABOUT US HYBRID SHOWS WHERE ELECTRONIC PRODUCTION MEETS REAL-TIME MUSICIANSHIP 39 KINGDOM is an international electronic duo known for their powerful hybrid performances, combining DJ sets with live instrumentation including vocals, guitar, and drums. Blending melodic techno, tech house, and indie dance, the project delivers a dynamic fusion of electronic music and live performance designed for both festival main stages and underground club environments. The concept behind 39 KINGDOM is built on the synergy between electronic production and real-time musicianship. Their performances combine high-energy club music with live elements that add emotion, spontaneity, and intensity, creating an immersive experience while maintaining a strong dancefloor-driven sound. Precision, musicality, and crowd connection remain at the core of every performance. MELODIC TECHNO TECH HOUSE INDIE DANCE LIVE VOCALS GUITAR DRUMS ✱ (03) PERFOR
